profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Google in New York City.

I work on Generative UI features on Google Search (AI Overview and AI Mode).

I used to work on the News on Search team creating features to better serve News content to users on Google Search and before that on Bloomberg's News Classification system, developing systems to perform highly performant entity classification on millions of news stories daily. I worked primarily with C++, Javascript, and Python.

I completed my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics at Purdue University.

Core Competencies:  C/C++/Java/JavaScript/Python, CI/CD, Github, Agile Product Development, Project Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Software Engineer on the News Enrichment Infrastructure Team

Working primarily on our news data pipeline that handles the enrichment of metadata on news stories to power applications like search, alerting, and analytics. Developing in C++ and Python to maintain the system, integrate new metadata enrichment services, and extract and load the relevant data that powers these enrichers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer on Bloomberg's Award Winning Electronic Order Management System for Fixed Income

Built and maintained application and backend for financial professionals to negotiate and place orders for fixed income instruments. The engine handles trade execution, reporting, and compliance as well as booking the trade for downstream applications to maintain order book status for the firm or trading desk.

Served in duel role as developer and scrum master, focusing primarily on list based trades of multiple securities simultaneously. Used C++ and JavaScript to add support for new security types, new price types, and built logging dashboards for easier trade debugging with Splunk.

positions.title: BLP-IT Intern
positions.description:
•	A member of the competitive Business Leadership Program in the Information Technology Function
•	Worked as a Java Developer building a RESTful web-application backend with Spring Boot
•	Designed a search algorithm utilizing the Watson Natural Language Understanding API
•	Used agile practices to manage the development of the web-application

Technologies Used:
•	Web Development (Back-end)
•	Java (Spring Boot)
•	MySQL
•	HTML
•	CSS
•	Javascript (jQuery)
•	R

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Leading efforts to develop robotics system using Python language for course material
•	Collaborating closely with engineering education professors to execute course
•	Overseeing collaboration & grading for three teams of honors students
•	Teaching core engineering skills, computer programming, and technical writing
•	Developing coaching skills (e.g., constructive feedback & guidance)

positions.title: Product Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Intern in the Ford Chassis development group
•	Interfaced with the customer to develop requirements and specifications
•	Collaborated with partners globally to produce prototype and production automotive parts
•	Managed project timeline to make sure parts were designed, assembled, and shipped to the customer on time.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
•	Developing relationships between campers from diverse backgrounds.
•	Responsible for leading and protecting 70 children though out the summer.

projects.title: JumpScience Android Application
projects.description:
-Personal project to make workouts more effective and using the JumpScience program less obtrusive
-Android app for use with the JumpScience plyometric program
-Utilizes Java, SQLite, and seeking to add cloud integration

projects.title: ENGR 14100 Project 3- Autonomous Robot for Use in a Mobile Thermal Depolymerization Plant
projects.description: The team developed an autonomous system as a proof of concept of a robot that would have the capabilities to sort bins of metallic, ceramic, and organic materials in a depolymerization plant.

organizations.name: Purdue Club Basketball
organizations.description:
- Practiced with team twice a week for two hours
- Competed in tournaments against opposing universities' club basketball teams

organizations.name: Purdue First Program
organizations.description:
- Member of Purdue FIRST Program for one semester
- Worked with the Public Relations team to reach out over different media to FIRST Robotics teams and the general public.
- In charge of hospitality, logistics, and supervising for FIRST competitions.
